title: COD and Due on Receipt are due on the invoice date
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have work order 1, complete and ready to invoice, for a customer on COD.
  • Have work order 2, complete and ready to invoice, for a customer on Due on Receipt.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1's Finance tab.
  2. Set Invoice Date to Oct 5, 2026.
  3. Open work order 2's Finance tab.
  4. Set Invoice Date to Oct 5, 2026.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The invoice preview shows.

Step 2:

  • The Due date reads Oct 5, 2026 (COD: the invoice date).

Step 3:

  • The invoice preview shows.

Step 4:

  • The Due date reads Oct 5, 2026 (Due on Receipt: the invoice date).
